statusText: A third US cash hour has passed without a genuine retracement. NDX is printing its session high at 30,370.05 (+2.45%) with the day low still the opening print, NQ is at its own 30,661.25 high, and semiconductors have accelerated to +3.69%. Repeated extension after no pullback, with yields, crude, megacaps and chips aligned, firms Tail inside the elevated band. Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES.
recommendation: A narrow elevated-risk window is flagged from 16:00Z to 19:00Z, covering the observed continuation leg through the US afternoon. Directional efficiency is currently high enough that mean reversion is unreliable within that window. The forecast has conditional Tail stepping beneath the elevated threshold from 19:00Z, easing further after the 20:00Z cash close, and returning to the quiet overnight baseline. The horizon contains no strong-block or off state at any hour.
headline: Nasdaq-100 holds a third cash hour without a pullback as semiconductors accelerate and crude slides below $100
body:
NQ futures traded 30,656.25 (+2.47%, +739.00) as of 16:16Z against a 29,904.00-30,661.25 day range, printing within five points of the session high and above the 30,582.25 high that stood an hour earlier. The NDX cash index was 30,370.05 (+2.45%) at 16:25Z on a 29,933.22-30,370.58 range, with the session low still the 29,947.16 opening area and Friday's close at 29,644.17. Three full cash hours have now produced no meaningful retracement.

Cross-asset confirmation has broadened rather than faded. The PHLX Semiconductor index is 12,361.82 (+3.69%) at its own session high, roughly doubling its advance from an hour earlier, with AMD up about 9.4%. The Treasury curve is lower across maturities: 2-year 4.74%, 5-year 4.82%, 10-year 4.96% and 30-year 5.29%. WTI has extended to -5.19% near $95.11 and Brent to -4.23% near $99.48, a fourth consecutive decline and an 11-day low attributed to expectations of US-Iran contact around the UN General Assembly and to Saudi shipments through the Strait of Hormuz recovering to about 2.9 million barrels a day. VIX is 14.95, up 0.95% but still inside a 14.60-14.99 range.

The catalyst stack remains one-sided and is now partly scheduled rather than live. Treasury Secretary Bessent called Sunday's talks with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng a very successful engagement and proposed a US-China AI notification mechanism; Xi Jinping's US visit is confirmed for September 23-25 with the summit on September 24. Today's US calendar is exhausted: the Chicago Fed National Activity Index printed at -0.04 and the 3-month and 6-month bill auctions have cleared, so no scheduled domestic release remains to refresh the move.

The assessment continues to follow price path rather than headlines. The escalation relative to the previous hour is specific and cumulative: the index again cleared its prior high while the day low stayed at the opening print, and the leading sector accelerated instead of stalling. That is repeated extension after no genuine pullback, the observed persistent-directional-efficiency case in which mean reversion is denied long enough to matter, and it justifies firming Tail modestly within the elevated band. Two features still cap the escalation rather than extending it. VIX remains inside a sub-15 range, describing an orderly grind rather than violent repricing, and with the US calendar exhausted there is no credible mechanism for a delayed second leg today. A third feature argues against the advance broadening: leadership is narrow, with the Dow up only a fraction of the Nasdaq's move and more than half of S&P 500 constituents below their 200-day averages, which raises Stress and lowers directional conviction without itself raising Tail. The elevated window is therefore drawn narrowly from 16:00Z to 19:00Z, and conditional Tail decays through the US afternoon and evening. A first genuine retracement remains the clearest invalidation of the current reading. Existing-position management and emergency protection are unaffected by this mapping.

lookbackSummary: The prior 24 hours document a regime change that is still running and still accelerating. Through Sunday's futures session and the Asian hours conditions were quiet and range-consistent, with Tail between 5 and 9 and mode normal. From roughly 06:00Z a steady bid built on the crude retreat and constructive US-China headlines: mode turned trend-up and Tail ratcheted from 5 to 22 across eight hourly assessments, crossing into the watch band at 11:00Z while confidence improved from 81 to 86. The 14:00Z assessment recorded the first crossing into the elevated band at the cash open at Tail 26, and 15:00Z firmed it to 28. Nineteen of the 24 hours carried a mapped EA_ON state and only the final two reached the block threshold, so the current reading is an extension of a two-hour-old escalation rather than a steady state.
outlookSummary: The forecast holds the elevated band for the observed continuation leg through the first two US afternoon hours, steps beneath the elevated threshold from 19:00Z as two-way positioning is assumed to return into the power hour, and eases further after the 20:00Z cash close. The overnight path returns to the quiet range baseline the lookback shows is typical outside US hours, then drifts up with Tuesday's European liquidity and again into Tuesday's US open, which is the horizon's key structural checkpoint. The horizon contains no strong-block or off state at any hour. Only the current clock-hour states observed structure as fact; every later hour frames structure conditionally, because no price path after 16:25Z has been observed. The current reading rests on repeated extension with the day low still at the open, so it should decay quickly once a genuine retracement appears. Confidence declines steadily with distance from the current evidence set. Wednesday's flash PMIs and the September 24 Trump-Xi summit are the next regime-relevant catalysts.
